saints.name: St. John of Matha
saints.title: Priest
saints.shortBlurb: A Paris theologian who founded an order to ransom Christians held captive by the Moors…
biography: John of Matha, born in Provence about 1160, studied at Paris and was ordained a priest. Moved by the plight of Christians enslaved by the Moors, he founded with St. Felix of Valois the Order of the Most Holy Trinity, approved by Pope Innocent III in 1198, whose members vowed to redeem captives, even offering themselves in exchange.
The Trinitarians spread through France, Spain, and North Africa, and over the centuries they, with the kindred Mercedarians, freed many thousands from bondage. John died at Rome in 1213.
saints.knownFor: Founding the Trinitarian Order for the ransom of captives.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 8 February
